usedFor: Recruitee holds candidates and offers, and Google Docs keeps the written record that “Add or Replace Text In Tab” updates.

bestTemplate.name: “Candidate Moved to Stage” in Recruitee, then “Add or Replace Text In Tab” in Google Docs
bestTemplate.why: A stage move is a hiring decision point, so each step gets recorded in a tab.

watchOut: “Candidate Moved to Stage” does not fire when a candidate enters the initial stage, so first entries are missed.
